entities.name: Aemilia Hilaria
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Aemilia Hilaria was a Gallo-Roman physician. She practiced medicine, and wrote books on gynecology and obstetrics. She was called "Hilaria" due to her cheerfulness as a baby.
